The stay gave me valuable insight into how high-quality placements and internships can be developed through long-term, trust-based partnerships between universities, students and local community organisations. Through meetings with colleagues at UMB, Eastern Michigan University, the University of Limerick, local partners and students, I was able to see how the different stakeholders contribute together to creating a comprehensive learning environment.
